items.explanation: Minutes can verify the start time.
An attendance record can settle the count.

items.text: The chair made the best decision.
items.explanation: “Best” is an evaluation, not a recorded measurement.

items.text: The final vote was four to two.
items.explanation: The recorded vote can confirm the numbers.

items.text: The result will certainly improve the city.
items.explanation: “Will certainly” makes a prediction that cannot yet be checked.
